title: Rebuttal is offered as playable with an empty chain (no spell exists to choose).
expected:
Reproduced empirically and traced in code. Harness scenario (P1 main phase, no chain/interaction, ven-152-166 in hand, 5 energy + mind/chaos power): `game.p1.legal()` returns a playSpell variant for Rebuttal with params {cardId, playerId} only (no targets) and `can("playSpell","R")` is true.

Root cause: the card's set-JSON has `abilities: [null]`, so all-cards.ts adaptJsonCard re-parses rulesText, and the parser yields a spell ability whose effect is `{type: "raw", text: "You may pay ... Otherwise, counter it."}` — the "Choose a spell with Energy cost no more than 4" clause produces no target descriptor and no counter/gain-control-of-spell effect type. Consequently:
- /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/targeting.ts:343-436 `spellEffectHasLegalTargets` — the `raw` effect matches none of the counter (line 402) / gain-control-of-spell (line 409) chain-gates and has no target/target1/etc., so it falls through to `return true` at line 436.
- /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/play-spell.ts:387-394 (condition) therefore passes, and the enumerator's final `else` at play-spell.ts:1323-1327 pushes a targetless `{cardId, playerId}` variant.
The engine's own convention (targeting.ts:399-412) is that a spell that must choose a spell on the chain is unplayable with no pending spell, so Rebuttal being offered with an empty chain is a real bug (card-def/parser gap surfacing through the engine's permissive raw-effect fallback).
observed: With chain empty in main phase, `moves` listed playSpell for player-1-main-999-ven-152-166 (no target params).

history.note: spellEffectHasLegalTargets gates a pay-cost conditional on its counter/gain-control branches, so Rebuttal is unplayable with an empty chain

resolution.note: spellEffectHasLegalTargets gates a pay-cost conditional on its counter/gain-control branches, so Rebuttal is unplayable with an empty chain
